[[File:Staff of earth detail.png|left|110px]]A '''staff of earth''' is the basic earth [[elemental staff]]. It provides unlimited amounts of [[Earth rune|earth runes]] as well as the [[autocast]] option when equipped. All elemental staves offer the same [[Magic]] bonuses and only differ by the type of [[Runes|rune]] they supply and their [[Melee]] stats.

The staff can be purchased from various shops across [[Gielinor]], including [[Zaff's Superior Staffs!]] in [[Varrock]]. It can also be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or found as a continually spawning item in the [[Lava Maze|lava maze]].

Players with access to a [[crystal ball]] within a [[player-owned house]] may change the element of this staff.
